<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Mental health care institute" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_FD" name="Family doctor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>startNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendCopy</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SEC" name="Secretarial office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inquire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>putThrough</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>storeInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>printInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwNew</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>createFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwNewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>storeForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>produceCards</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addNotices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>storeAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>passCards</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>splitIntakes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwMed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informSecond</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addCopy</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwMerge2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>typeTapes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addTapes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>joinIntakes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>listPatients</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>provideList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_NO" name="Nursing officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>recordForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handIn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_TL" name="Team leader">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>holdMeeting</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>recordAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>determineFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>treatmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_FI" name="First intaker (social-medical worker)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>planMeetingFI</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>examine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notebook</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>putNotes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addChecklist</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SI" name="Second intaker (physician)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>planMeetingSI</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>holdMeetingSI</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>dictaphone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="startNeed" name="Patient in need of mental treatment" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify" name="Notify the institute by telephone" />
    <bpmn:task id="inquire" name="Inquire after the name and residence of the patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="putThrough" name="Put the doctor through to the nursing officer" />
    <bpmn:task id="inquiry" name="Make a full inquiry into the mental, health and social state of the patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="recordForm" name="Record the information on the registration form" />
    <bpmn:task id="handIn" name="Hand in the registration form at the secretarial office" />
    <bpmn:task id="storeInfo" name="Store the information in the information system" />
    <bpmn:task id="printInfo" name="Print the information from the information system" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwNew" name="New patient?" />
    <bpmn:task id="createFile" name="Create a patient file" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwNewMerge" />
    <bpmn:task id="storeForm" name="Store the registration form and the print in the patient file" />
    <bpmn:task id="produceCards" name="Produce two registration cards" />
    <bpmn:task id="addNotices" name="Add the new patient to the list of new notices" />
    <bpmn:task id="holdMeeting" name="Hold the staff meeting of the medical team" />
    <bpmn:task id="assign" name="Assign each new patient to a first and second intaker" />
    <bpmn:task id="recordAssign" name="Record the assignments on the assignment list" />
    <bpmn:task id="determineFile" name="Determine whether the medical file is required" />
    <bpmn:task id="handOver" name="Hand over the assignment list to the secretarial office" />
    <bpmn:task id="storeAssign" name="Store the assignment of each patient in the information system" />
    <bpmn:task id="passCards" name="Pass the registration cards to the first and second intaker" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="splitIntakes" />
    <bpmn:task id="planMeetingFI" name="Plan a meeting with the patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="examine" name="Examine the patient using the standard checklist" />
    <bpmn:task id="notebook" name="Register additional observations in a personal notebook" />
    <bpmn:task id="putNotes" name="Put a copy of the notes in the patient file" />
    <bpmn:task id="addChecklist" name="Add the standard checklist to the patient file" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwMed" name="Medical file required?" />
    <bpmn:task id="letter" name="Send a letter to the family doctor requesting a copy of the medical file" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendCopy" name="Send a copy of the medical file" />
    <bpmn:task id="informSecond" name="Inform the second intaker" />
    <bpmn:task id="addCopy" name="Add the copy to the patient file" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwMerge2" />
    <bpmn:task id="planMeetingSI" name="Plan the first meeting with the patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="holdMeetingSI" name="Hold the first meeting with the patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="dictaphone" name="Record the observations on a dictaphone" />
    <bpmn:task id="typeTapes" name="Type out the dictaphone tapes" />
    <bpmn:task id="addTapes" name="Add the typed information to the patient file" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="joinIntakes" />
    <bpmn:task id="listPatients" name="Add the patient to the list of patients that reach this status" />
    <bpmn:task id="provideList" name="Provide the team leader with a list of these patients" />
    <bpmn:task id="treatmentPlan" name="Formulate the treatment plan" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endDone" name="Intake procedure ended" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f01" sourceRef="startNeed" targetRef="notify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f02" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="inquire" />
